component.name: WittyMediaPlayer
component.summary: Play video, audio, DVDs and Blu-rays with their real menus

description.p: A desktop player for video, audio, DVDs and Blu-rays on your own computer, with the discs' real menus. It plays from a drive, a disc image or a folder, with no server and no account.

ul.li: Finds the film on a disc that hides it among decoy titles, and says why it chose that title.
Offers a film's other cuts and a TV disc's episodes, and remembers the one you choose.
Plays audio CDs and images, and copies them to FLAC, ALAC, WAV, MP3, AAC, Opus or Ogg Vorbis.
Nothing leaves your computer unless you press a button that says so. Copy-protected discs are refused: nothing is decrypted.
